title: Robredo casts vote as Naga seeks highly urbanized city status

blocks.text: NAGA CITY — Mayor Leni Robredo cast her vote at the Naga City Science High School on Saturday morning, Nov. 21, in a plebiscite seeking to ratify the city’s conversion into a Highly Urbanized City (HUC). President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signed Proclamation No. 1267 on May 26, 2026, declaring Naga City a Highly Urbanized City,
